title: A merge answer with no merged field is reported as a merge
what: In merge, only merged == false is treated as a refusal. An answer that carries no merged field at all (an empty or non-JSON body, which write turns into Value::Null) falls through to Ok with an empty commit id, so chat_finish tells the user the pull request merged and deletes the local branch although GitHub never confirmed a merge.
expected: A merge answer that does not say merged: true should be an error carrying what GitHub said, so the user is told it did not merge and the local branch is kept.
